response.question: Can the available evidence establish that sensor noise caused the wrong poses?
response.message: HAND-AUTHORED EVALUATOR FIXTURE; no model call

findings.text: Recorded outcomes cannot identify sensor noise as a cause. A controlled noise diagnostic is only a proposed check.

evidence.scope: Two curated examples only; not the entire dataset
Tested historical baseline and frozen internal T-LESS configuration; not an official BOP score. GT visible instance masks were used.
evidence.pilot: The local feedback-free search pilot demonstrated no advantage over random search; all five baselines were already wrong. Deterministic included 15 no-ops, random none.
evidence.experimental: Scan-to-model and reciprocal refinements remain experimental; neither is a production improvement.
evidence.AI: Optional remote model proposals are implemented but live integration remains unverified. No model calls contributed to this demo; deterministic schedules are not adaptive AI.
evidence.historical_provenance: Scoring audit provenance does not establish original held-out execution source identity.
